title: Dungeon quest bonus XP cut 50%
claim: Dungeon quests now give 50% less of their extra XP above normal quest XP (beta build of Oct 1); base quest XP is unchanged.
detail: PC Gamer measured Deviate Hides (Wailing Caverns): about 4,650 XP before the change, about 3,100 after (Classic: 1,600). Dungeon quest gear rewards also dropped from blue to green and some rewards were recalibrated (Icy Veins). Blizzard: "We appreciate the feedback on leveling speed". Devs said they would revisit dungeon XP as the cap rises.

title: Dungeon mob kill XP reduced
claim: XP from killing dungeon mobs was also reduced in the beta; no figure has been published.
detail: Reported by Icy Veins alongside the quest bonus cut; players report solo dungeon XP farming and boosting are much weaker. Treat dungeon grinding as worse than in Classic until numbers are measured.

title: Lower-level (green) mobs give 4-20% less XP than Classic
claim: Kill XP for mobs below your level is lower than Classic by about 4-20% (the formula uses the mob's level); same-level and higher mobs are unchanged. Blizzard says this is intended, to offset food and campfire rested XP.
detail: Analysis by u/Deadness on r/classicwow; Senior Game Designer Aidan 'Zirene' Moon on the forever-bugs tracker (#138): not a bug, intended now that XP buffs like eating food exist. Glide's own kill records fit the same mob-level formula (5 x mob level + 45 for lower-level mobs). Practical effect: kill mobs at or above your level; green-mob grinding is worse than in Classic.

title: Beta phase 2: level cap 30
claim: The beta level cap is 30 since Oct 1: Excavation Site: Wetlands (26-31, new dungeon) opened, Razorfen Downs (25+) and Uldaman (30+) are accessible; Hillsbrad Foothills and Stonetalon Mountains are in; 10 more talent points.
detail: The new City of Dalaran dungeon is delayed (Aggrend on X). Launch is Nov 4.

title: Faster respawns in five zones
claim: Creature and object respawns were sped up in Hillsbrad Foothills, Ashenvale, Wetlands, Duskwood and Thousand Needles (Oct 1); Loch Modan troggs for one quest respawn more slowly; Taillasher Eggs (Break A Few Eggs) respawn slower than intended (known issue).
detail: Also fixed: escort quests failing with 25+ quests in the log; quests that gave duplicate items. New quest 'Kyle's Gone Missing!' in Mulgore.

title: Campfire: any resting pose works, no damage below level 5
claim: The Campfire buff is gained while sitting, in a chair, sleeping, lying down or kneeling, and you can cast, craft and buff others while waiting; since Oct 1 campfires no longer damage players below level 5 and deal reduced damage below 90% health.
detail: Boosted Rest debuff got a clearer tooltip (Oct 1). Sept 24 build notes for the pose and casting change.

title: Average 1-20 time equals Classic Era
claim: Blizzard's numbers: average 1-20 leveling time is 20.5 hours on Forever vs 20.4 hours on Classic Era; Forever is not designed to level faster, only differently.
detail: From the Blizzard WoW Forever developer podcast (50:09). Devs mentioned some quests may give only XP and gold, or one blue instead of four, in a later build.

title: Druid Wrath base damage up about 50%
claim: Druid Wrath base damage was raised by about 50% in the Sept 24 beta build, which makes caster-form leveling much stronger early on.
detail: Same build: Hunter Tame Beast restrictions, Mage Hot Streak raised to 20 seconds, Gnome Eureka! now a 10% resource discount for every class, Tauren Cultivation per-herb level requirements. Oct 1: Druid Tiger's Fury removed (Feral gains Shifting Power), Mage Combustion back to 3 charges, Warrior Fury tree reworked.

title: Hunter: Concussive Shot stun talent now always procs (datamined)
claim: Players report the rank-5 talent that lets Concussive Shot stun now has a 100% proc chance (was 20%), a 3-second stun; seen in client data, no patch note yet.
detail: Blizzard forums thread 'Hunters just got more buffs' (Oct 8); no staff confirmation. Rogue players report nerfs the same day ('RIP Rogues'); Blizzard published Class Deep Dives for Rogue/Warlock (Oct 7) and Mage/Shaman (Oct 8).

title: 1,792 new-in-Forever quest IDs datamined
claim: The Forever client's quest table has 1,792 quest IDs that are not in Classic Era (ForeverQuestMarker, build 1.60.1.69977); Glide now uses them to tell new quests from Classic ones and to scan them first.
detail: Source data from wago.tools via the ForeverQuestMarker addon project; community-confirmed and changed-quest lists will follow as players submit reports.
